raw_response:
我今年就把这 10 亩地都放在冬小麦-夏玉米一年两熟上，冬夏用的是同一块地，不再分散种别的。曲周本来就是典型的麦玉轮作区，研究里提到全县 80% 以上耕地都在走这个制度，而且夏天雨多、冬春偏干，水主要卡在小麦季，这和我这边的地情、水情是对得上的。[Quzhou 轮作研究](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5290742/) 也说明了这一点。县里近年主推的也是冬小麦-夏玉米周年水肥一体化技术，[中国农大曲周实验站](https://qzsyz.cau.edu.cn/art/2024/2/25/art_46232_1012984.html)一直在本地推。2024 年曲周“绿色吨半粮”示范里，小麦亩产做到 707 到 725 公斤、玉米亩产 796 到 797 公斤，[本地示范数据](https://qzsyz.cau.edu.cn/art/2024/10/8/art_46317_1039835.html)让我更愿意继续守住这套种法。施肥上，我会把小麦按华北灌溉冬麦区的思路做分次施氮，[农业农村部冬小麦施肥意见](https://www.moa.gov.cn/gk/nszd_1/2023/202309/t20230928_6437567.htm)；玉米按华北平原夏玉米的目标产量档次控氮、配磷钾，[农业农村部夏玉米施肥意见](https://www.moa.gov.cn/govpublic/ZZYGLS/201006/t20100606_1534673.htm)。我 70 岁了，图的是稳产、省工、机械化好操作，所以我会把品种压缩到这两样主粮，少折腾高劳动强度的经济作物。

decision.reasoning_summary: I will keep all 10 mu in the local winter wheat-summer maize double-cropping system because that is the dominant and most reliable pattern in Quzhou County, where summer rainfall supports maize and irrigation is concentrated in the wheat season. I want a simple, mechanized, low-labor plan that still holds yield, so I will use an improved wheat variety and a hybrid maize variety, apply moderate but sufficient fertilizer based on local high-yield practice, irrigate wheat three times and maize once, return residues, and rely on rotary tillage before wheat plus no-tillage direct seeding for maize. My target is steady grain production rather than chasing extra crop diversity.
